extDescription.message: Chrome's new tab opens Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any other site directly, while your cursor stays in the address bar.

actionTitle.message: Choose what opens in new tabs

tagline.message: Your AI chat in every new tab. Your cursor stays in the address bar.

welcomePick.message: Pick what opens in your new tabs, below.

welcomeSignIn.message: Sign in once in a regular tab: sign-in pages can't load inside the new tab.

welcomeKeep.message: On your first new tab, Chrome may ask whether to keep this new tab page. Keep it.

welcomeFooter.message: Optional: to hide Chrome's footer at the bottom of new tabs, right-click it and choose to hide it.

customHint.message: Any site, or a specific page: a ChatGPT or Claude project, a custom GPT, a self-hosted chat…

keepCursor.message: Keep the cursor in the address bar

keepCursorHint.message: Recommended. The site loads inside the new tab, and you can still type a search or a URL right away. Turn it off to open the site as a regular page instead: the page takes the cursor, but everything works, including artifact and canvas previews.

keepCursorHintShort.message: Type a search or URL right away. Off: open the site as a regular page.

saved.message: Saved. Open a new tab ($SHORTCUT$) to try it.

invalidUrl.message: Enter a valid web address, like gemini.google.com.

accessDenied.message: Saved. Without access to this site it can't load inside the new tab, so it will open as a regular page.

disclaimer.message: Not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.
